_comment: Canned /api/search offers for visual work, so the layout can be iterated without spending live searches (the Bearer lane allows 3 per 10 minutes). Field shapes and values are copied from real GDN->BCN and WAW->LIS responses. Deliberately mixed: direct and connecting, next-day arrivals, bags included and not, a virtual interline, a carrier the logo CDN has no art for (U2), and one with no airline_code at all, so both the logo path and the initials fallback are on screen at once. NOTE: no booking_url on any offer -- the live API returns none, so the deep link is built from search_id + offer id.
